rows: Header of the help panel. It should contain the only `h2` used in the help panel.

Main content of the help panel. Use `p, a, h3, h4, h5, span, div, ul, ol, li, code, pre, dl, dt, dd, hr, br, i, em, b, strong` tags to format the content. Use `code` for inline code or `pre` for code blocks.
Renders the panel in a loading state. We recommend that you also set a `loadingText`.
Specifies the text that's displayed when the panel is in a loading state. @i18n
